Seven comments

Gillian’s Waltz from Sesson A9’s What Road

I’ve written in various grace notes, but they are actually slides into the following notes - I just couldn’t get that into the Abc notation.
On the CD this is played AABB Solo, AABB Group, Piano interlude, AA Solo, AA Group, Piano fadeout…

This is one of my favourite CDs and I would like to get all the tunes into abc - will take some time…

Chris

↳ Posted by Crackpot on October 6th, 2006.

Gillian’s Waltz

The guy that wrote this tune - Gordon Gunn is my fiddle teacher. I know this tune really well and you’ve done a pretty good job of writing it out the only thing is the 2nd part is much longer but I really like your little variations here and there =]

↳ Posted by theshadedfiddler on July 31st, 2007.
